items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: I never got to know him. I never heard him.

ctx.x: Oh, George Field. I never got to meet him. I think he got on police force. He got to be a detective. Who was your favorite of all the trombone players? He died in Chicago.
He died in Chicago. George Field.
Did you know him? I was a trombone player, too, wasn't he? Yes, from downtown.

items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: I knew him. ... That's the man that I was trying to get to hear about. ... I know George Field.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. I see. Did you ever know George Field?
Yeah. George Field, I wait. I knew him.
He was a trombone player. He went up to Chicago.
